description: Parse a pasted block of raw HTTP response headers (one "Name: value" pair per line) and score it against commonly recommended security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and the three Cross-Origin-* isolation headers), with an overall 0-100 score and A-F letter grade. Evaluates the header text you give it, not a live request.

headers.description: Raw response headers, one "Name: value" pair per line

name: score_security_headers
